description: Frozen blind benchmark task design for PolyFlow/RCIR agent validation under Rule 0.3.

tasks.title: Add Optional Crop Parameter to Preview Thumbnail
tasks.instructions: Update ApiController getThumbnail to accept an optional $crop parameter with default true: public function getThumbnail($x, $y, $file, $crop = true), and pass $crop to $this->previewManager->getPreview($file, $x, $y, $crop).

tasks.title: Add Permanent Deletion Flag to NodeDeletedEvent
tasks.instructions: Update NodeDeletedEvent to declare a protected boolean property $permanent = false, and a public getter method: public function isPermanent(): bool { return $this->permanent; }

tasks.title: Add ID Verification Method to IShare Contract
tasks.instructions: Update IShare interface to declare a method hasId(): public function hasId(): bool; for checking if the share instance has an assigned internal id.

tasks.title: Add Existence Check Method to IConfig Contract
tasks.instructions: Update IConfig interface to declare a method hasSystemValue(): public function hasSystemValue(string $key): bool; for checking if a system configuration key exists.

tasks.title: Add Active Session Status Check to IUserSession Contract
tasks.instructions: Update IUserSession interface to declare a method hasActiveSession(): public function hasActiveSession(): bool; to query whether an authenticated user session is active.
